jobs.description: Amazon Leo is closing the digital divide with a constellation of 3,236 low-Earth-orbit (LEO) satellites bringing fast, affordable broadband to communities the internet has never reliably reached. The customer terminal is the phased-array antenna at the customer's premises that turns that constellation into a working internet link — and our team writes the embedded software that makes it work: acquiring a LEO satellite on a fast overhead pass, electronically steering the beam to track it, closing and holding the link, and handing over to the next satellite within seconds. This is a broad role — you can work across the full signal chain and go deep wherever interests you most. What you'll work on: • Electronic beam steering & tracking — real-time control that keeps a phased-array beam pointed at a fast-moving satellite across the pass and through every handover. • Phased-array calibration — per-element amplitude/phase calibration that holds beam and sidelobe performance across unit-to-unit variation, temperature, and frequency, on real hardware in the field, with the automated test coverage to keep it reliable. • Link acquisition, tracking & management — satellite acquisition, closed-loop tracking, and the control that brings the link up, keeps it healthy, and reacquires cleanly through handovers. • RF power & thermal management — managing transmit power and duty cycle against PA and platform thermal limits so the terminal runs at full performance without exceeding its envelope. • System integration & field telemetry — integrate the RF front-end, controls, and signal path, then use device telemetry to debug and improve terminals operating on orbit. Key job responsibilities What we look for: • Embedded C/C++ or Rust on Linux/RTOS, close to the hardware. • Wireless / RF / DSP exposure — phased arrays, beamforming, SatCom, 5G/LTE, radar, or similar — or strong drive to grow into it. • Hands-on hardware debugging — comfortable with lab instruments, RF test setups, and reading telemetry to reason about a live system. Our stack: Rust, C/C++, and Python on embedded Linux / RTOS, working directly with the RF front-end and real hardware — lab terminals, RF test benches, and satellites on orbit. Automated hardware-in-the-loop testing and rich fleet telemetry let you see the impact of your code in the real world. New development is increasingly in Rust. Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. A day in the life As part of our BSP software engineering team, you will design and implement embedded software used in the Project Kuiper products. You will work in a collaborative environment with teams inside and outside of Amazon. You will craft your software from requirements, designs, code, test, to product deployment. You need to be flexible and responsive to changing priority issues. About the team The Kuiper Customer Terminal Software Team supports the devices that connect our customers to the Kuiper network. We provide software for both applications and the underlying Linux system. We work hand in hand with hardware, product and operations teams to deliver a great experience for our customers.

Turn financial insight into better business decisions.

At Securian Financial, Finance is more than reporting the numbers. Our Finance Business Partners work alongside leaders across the organization to understand what is driving performance, anticipate financial needs and turn complex data into insights that help the business make better decisions.

We’re looking for an experienced IT Finance Business Partner to join our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team. In this highly collaborative role, you’ll serve as a trusted financial advisor to leaders across our Information Technology (IT) organization and Enterprise Consulting & Project Management Office (ECPMO).

You’ll bring together financial expertise, business acumen and strong relationship-building skills to help leaders manage expenses, evaluate investments, understand financial tradeoffs and make informed decisions. From annual planning and forecasting to technology cost management and business cases, you’ll have the opportunity to influence decisions that impact both Technology and the broader enterprise.

What you'll do

Partner with leaders and influence decisions

• Build trusted relationships with IT and ECPMO leaders, serving as a strategic finance thought partner and advisor.
• Translate financial data and complex analyses into clear, compelling insights that help leaders understand performance, risks and opportunities.
• Anticipate leaders' financial needs and develop tools, reporting and analysis that support better and faster decision-making.
• Strengthen financial acumen across the organization by coaching leaders on FP&A concepts, expense management and financial tradeoffs.

Lead planning, budgeting and forecasting

• Lead financial planning, budgeting and forecasting activities for supported IT and ECPMO areas.
• Partner with leaders to understand strategic initiatives, staffing plans and investment priorities and translate them into financial plans.
• Analyze actual and forecasted results, identify key drivers of variance and help leaders develop strategies to address gaps against financial targets.
• Support quarterly close activities, including accrual reviews and analysis to ensure complete and accurate financial results.

Drive effective technology expense management

• Provide insight into direct and allocated technology expenses and help leaders understand the financial impact of their decisions.
• Apply technology financial management concepts, including total cost of ownership, to support investment and expense decisions.
• Identify opportunities to optimize expenses and partner with Finance and business leaders on enterprise expense-management strategies.
• Develop and evaluate business cases, including cost-benefit analyses, to help leaders assess investments and competing priorities.

Improve how Finance works

• Collaborate across FP&A and Technology to improve financial reporting, analytics, dashboards and decision-support tools.
• Leverage technology, data and automation to simplify processes and deliver more meaningful financial insights.
• Bring external perspectives and best practices in technology finance and FP&A to continuously improve how we support the business.
• Help lead financial process and system changes by engaging stakeholders, driving adoption and supporting effective transitions.

What you'll bring

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
• Significant experience in financial planning and analysis, including budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling and variance analysis.
• Experience supporting Technology/IT financial management, with an understanding of technology costs, investments and total cost of ownership.
• Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to move beyond reporting results to identifying insights, implications and recommended actions.
• Demonstrated ability to build credibility and trusted relationships with senior business leaders and cross-functional partners.
• Strong communication, presentation and financial storytelling skills, including the ability to make complex financial information understandable and actionable.
• Experience developing or evaluating business cases and cost-benefit analyses.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and the ability to identify root causes and challenge assumptions.
• Experience using financial, analytics or business intelligence tools; experience with Apptio, SAP or similar platforms is valuable.
• Interest in leveraging data, technology and automation to improve financial processes, reporting and decision support.
• Ability to navigate change, competing priorities and ambiguity while working collaboratively across teams.
• A proactive, self-directed approach with strong organizational and time-management skills.

What will help you stand out

You’ll be especially successful in this role if you enjoy operating at the intersection of Finance, Technology and strategy. You know how to dig into the numbers, but you’re equally comfortable stepping away from the spreadsheet to help a leader understand what the numbers mean, what choices they have and what action they should consider next.

You bring curiosity, sound judgment and a consultative mindset—and you’re energized by the opportunity to make Finance an even stronger strategic partner to the business.

Job Description: FBAR Filter Designer Role Overview We are seeking an FBAR Filter Designer to lead the development of high-performance RF Front-End (RFFE) solutions. Collaboration: Partner with process, modeling, test, module, and other design teams to correlate simulations with measured lab data and drive design iterations.
